headline: South Africa Seeks to Resolve Trade Tensions After US AGOA Termination Plan
summary: The South African government remains committed to resolving trade tensions with the United States after President Donald Trump announced plans to terminate the country's participation in AGOA from January 2027.
why: The African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) provides duty-free access to the US market for qualifying sub-Saharan African nations, making its continuation vital for regional trade and bilateral relations.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: The planned termination of AGOA participation directly impacts South Africa's trade framework with the United States.
